verdict.rationale: Skyfire states that all its tokens conform to the open KYAPay protocol, a published industry specification for signed JWT identity/payment credentials (KYAPay.org). That gives developers an open protocol to build against, but charging, wallets and settlement remain proprietary Skyfire APIs. No protocol versioning, published machine-readable schema or conformance suite is evidenced, the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404, and the introspect endpoint only checks token usability and balance rather than validating conformance. Missing for 10: protocol versioning, a published schema (JSON Schema/OpenAPI), conformance or validation tooling, independent corroboration.
